env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# REDTEAM255: segment scope cleanup runs before function cleanup, at the
# lexical block exit, on rejected filter elements, and during panic unwind.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_scope_defer.lgo a/main.lgo
cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_scope_defer.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_scope_defer.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_scope_defer.out

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstagescopedefer

go 1.27
